description:
Maintain and troubleshoot existing portal systems.

 Develop and implement enhancements and updates to the current portal.

 Analyze business and system requirements and ensure technical feasibility.

 Design and develop software using Java, Maven, Spring Framework, and Oracle.

 Collaborate with internal stakeholders and external vendors; provide technical direction and support.

 Write clean, efficient, and testable code.

 Ensure quality and stability through code reviews, unit testing, and debugging.

 Support deployment, integration, and ongoing system reliability.

 
 5+ years of Java development experience

 Proficiency with Java, Vue.js,  Maven, Spring, Oracle, and PostgreSQL

 Bilingual: Korean and English

 Onsite work in Irvine, CA is required.

 Start date expected within 2–3 weeks of final interview.

  
 Salary:  $90K (DOE) /yr. 

 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
  *** NO C2C ***
